description: Hurricane IAN Data from Wireless Pressure Sensor Network and LiDAR is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Chelakara Subramanian, Florida Institute of Technology (fit.edu). The Florida Tech Wireless Sensor Network System (FIT WSNS) and Florida Tech LiDAR measured and recorded pressure, temperature and wind data during the passage of Hurricane Ian from 2022/9/27 to 2022/9/30, in Satellite Beach, Florida. Coverage: Satellite Beach, FL. DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Field Deployment, Hurricane Ian, Wireless Sensor Network System, LiDAR, Wind Pressure, Building Envelope. Published 2023-08-29. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
